# Spec questions

Questions from engine authors and RE lanes that a spec has to answer from the original. This file is only a
generated index: the questions live one file per spec, so read only the file for your spec.

## How the files work

- Open questions for `docs/specs/<spec>.md` are in `docs/specs/questions/<spec>.md`. Read that file, not the
  others. `docs/specs/questions/answered/<spec>.md` is an archive; lanes do not read it.
- To ask a question, append an entry at the END of your spec's file (create the file if the spec has none).
  The ID keeps the spec's subsystem prefix and continues its numbering: use the next free ID in the table
  below. Put `<!-- from: <lane> (<date>) -->` on the line above the entry.
- When a question is answered, write the answer into the spec, then move the entry (struck through, with an
  `**ANSWERED <date>**` line) from the open file to the end of `answered/<spec>.md`.
- Do not edit this file. Run `python tools/questions.py index` after you change a question file and
  `python tools/questions.py check` before you commit. `python tools/questions.py find <ID>` locates an ID.
- Details: `docs/specs/questions/README.md`.
